cloudBridgeUrl.title: Coffee Link/Ayla bridge URL
cloudBridgeUrl.description: Optional HTTPS bridge endpoint. It must expose GET /status and POST /command.

lanIp.title: Known machine IP
lanIp.description: Optional; discovery will use this first.

discoveryUrl.title: Discovery endpoint
discoveryUrl.description: Optional authenticated endpoint returning { ip }. The plugin does not guess or control a LAN protocol.

allowUnverifiedLanControl.title: Allow unverified LAN control
allowUnverifiedLanControl.description: Unsafe and unsupported. Keep disabled; LAN discovery does not enable direct control.
